name: Purple Magic
description:
Reality is woven together by hidden symbologies: names, blood, dreams, love, fate, memory and the moon and stars. A student of the craft understands these invisible threads and quietly tugs upon them.

Purple magic is the left-handed path of magic, available only to female characters. This is the magic of the twilight and the aurora, deep and subtle. Users can employ a variety of strong charms, illusions and curses.

name: Gold Magic
description:
Stories, beauty and myth shape reality. Gold magic practitioners imitate powers older than humanity, borrowing fragments of the Otherworld and using their own charisma to influence people, places and things. 

Gold magic flows from the mystical plane of Faerie, although it's relationship with the Fey folk remains slightly unsettling to many practitioners. This is the magic of enchantment, binding and protection. Its practitioners use the most potent blessings and the strongest charms and illusions of any school, but little else.

name: White Magic
description:
The universe possesses moral order, and those invested with rightful authority may call upon it through ceremony and devotion. White magic is the exercise of this sacred office.

The divine magic of holiness, healing and blessings. Other than the most potent healing and blessings of any school, it also offers strong transmutations and charms.

name: Blue Magic
description:
The world is composed of primordial elemental forces that can be channelled by those with innate talent. The Blue magic caster does not command or calculate; they simply invoke. Fire burns, rivers flow, mountains endure, and the caster merely calls those truths into the present.

Blue magic users draw power from the four elements of earth, air, fire and water. They can employ extremely dangerous evocations, conjurations, and transmutations.

name: Black Magic
description:
There are no forbidden acts, only prices that weaker people refuse to pay. The Black magic practitioner believes that personal will is sufficient justification for any sacrifice, provided the reward is worth the cost.

The mastery of curses, terror and necromancy. Black magic users have access to strong illusions and evocations, and the strongest curses available to any school.

name: Red Magic
description:
Reality is governed by immutable laws which can be mastered through disciplined thought and perfect execution. Physics and the mind are merely systems waiting to be understood and exploited.

The right-handed path of magic, only available to male characters. This is the magic of runes, wind, force and thought. Direct and powerful, it employs strong curses and the most dangerous evocations of any school.

name: Green Magic
description:
The world already knows what it should be. Green magic neither commands nor creates; it remembers. Every spell restores forgotten balance, recalls ancient truths or accepts one's place within the eternal cycles of life.

Power over plants, animals and natural forces. These casters can employ a variety of healing, blessing and shape changing spells, and have the strongest conjuration options.
